name: PT Quantum Clovera Investama Tbk
summary: PT Quantum Clovera Investama Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in business activities in the fields of technology and digital services in Indonesia. It operates through Financial and Investment; and Technology and Digital segments. The company offers clean energy products and services, digital wholesale services, content entertainment products, digital product aggregation services, digital cloud advertising, and IoT products.
